items.text:
Joining Fairfield Fitness is straightforward, but the paperwork trips a lot of people up. Your first month is pro-rated from the date you sign, then billed on the 1st. If you join with a friend you both get a free assessment; bring photo ID and proof of address, because the direct debit mandate needs to match the name on your bank account. Pausing for medical reasons is free with a note from your GP; pausing for holidays costs £5 a month and can't cover more than eight weeks in a rolling year.

Membership numbers from the pilot will be reported at the September committee meeting; the early figures (roughly 340 sign-ups in six weeks) have already been circulated to the leisure portfolio holder and shouldn't be quoted publicly yet.

items.text:
The password policy's 180-day rotation applies to all staff accounts, including contractors. Service accounts use 365-day rotation and are exempt from complexity rules but must be vault-managed. MFA is mandatory for anyone who can reach the admin console. Since January the helpdesk no longer resets passwords by phone; use the self-service portal or open a ticket. The audit log of policy exceptions is reviewed monthly by the security lead.
